title: Fabulous!!
text: This was a fabulous tour, the directions were easy to understand and having the map to follow was also helpful. The explanations and descriptions of each place were excellent. The tour took us around 3 hrs but we stopped for a coffee and toured a palace during the walk. Highly recommend this self-guided tour.
author: 477jennyr

title: Great!
text: A clear tour with fascinating history through a beautiful neighborhood with narrow streets.
author: Jannie V

title: In the absence of a...
text: In the absence of a guided tour of the Jewish Quarter being available, this audio tour did the job - taking us to places we wouldn't have seen, giving us interesting history and commentary, and allowing us to go at our own pace.
